name: Zoetry Agua Punta Cana
insider_take: A zen sanctuary where wellness meets Caribbean luxury – this adults-only hideaway feels more like a boutique spa retreat than a traditional resort.
whats_special: This intimate all-inclusive sits on a pristine stretch of Uvero Alto Beach, featuring only 96 suites spread across lush tropical gardens. The property embraces a "Endless Privileges" philosophy with no schedules, no wristbands, and no reservations required – just pure relaxation with complimentary spa treatments included in your stay.
pro_tip: Book the complimentary 25-minute spa service early in your stay, then upgrade to longer treatments at the world-class Zoëtry Spa for the ultimate wellness experience.
dont_miss: The cenote-inspired spa pools and the beachfront yoga pavilion at sunrise. Take advantage of the complimentary excursions to explore nearby Hoyo Azul cenote or venture to the historic Basilica de Higüey, the most important Catholic pilgrimage site in the Caribbean.
pros: Intimate boutique resort with personalized service
Stunning beachfront location with pristine white sand
cons: Higher price point than neighboring resorts
